CheckTitle: Log profile captures activity logs for all regions
Description: Verify that Azure Monitor log profiles are configured to export activity logs for all regions.
Risk: Missing logs from certain regions can create blind spots in security monitoring.

Code.CLI: az monitor log-profiles create --name default --categories Write Delete Action --days 365 --enabled true --location eastus --locations $(az account list-locations --query '[].name' -o tsv) global --storage-account-id <storage-account-id>

Recommendation.Text: Update log profiles to include all active regions and 'global'.
